name: s81dv_land_pvrd

pin_regs.reason: OWNER RULE 19:50 opt-out (as the coordinator-approved S81 relays / landing frames): the lane input i IS captured flop-first into the ring slots on ck_f (LANDING-CONTRACT L1) and every live output bit is a flop on ck (o, flop-last, L2); k / nw / rb are identity die-tie straps (case-analysed), fault is the OR of two sticky flops. A flow pin register would add an edge the die calendar (N + 1 + E + 1) does not price.

structural_change: S81-DIE7/PVRD 10-18: first hardened view of dsfd_dvland_pvrd (S81-DIE5 RTL; 2 instances in bind9 / p4l: links pv_W -> s_3S, pv_E -> s_4S, from svc entries rsv_05 / rsv_11 over one dsfd_dvrlyh_562 chain, 2 stations, E 2 / K 2 / D 4): the P.V 562-b lane LANDING (ot_s81_land W 562 D 4: ring written on the forwarded lane clock ck_f, read on the slice root ck at K) + a static fixed-latency width adapter (one register, +1 edge) into the C3 slice band port bi (1104-b RD beat: leaf w mod 5, row rb + 4 (w div 5), pairs 2). No ready, no backpressure, no credit; fault = slot-epoch check | head-flag calendar slip (assertion only). Two CTS roots (ck receiver root, ck_f lane capture), related same frequency, fixed-latency ring. Faces from the p4l plan: lane i + ck_f on S (from rsv_05 / rsv_11 below), o abutted N to the slice S-face band port bi with the slice root ck and regional reset rs, straps / fault on W. Recipe 4 flop-first, hold_budget die, M5 cap. | p2: outline 151.2 x 23.76 (p1 gate 172.8 x 34.56: std 1,695 um2, util 33%); pin-limited face strip (1,106 pins on N at 7.3/um, as the 276/562 relays), abutted along the slice S face. | p3: outline 155.52 x 25.92 (p2 route FLOORPLAN_MARGIN util 60.3%, std 1,722 um2 in 2,855; now ~53%), pins unchanged. | p4 (ROOT4-S81POST 10-19): S81-SMWIRE SO bypass (main 0408184bd) -- l[561] selects kind-2 SO B words (0 cycles, same o register edge); SAFE checklist: 1 pins PASS (ring capture flop-first on ck_f, o flop-last, opt-out unchanged), 2 reach PASS (155 x 26 um), 3 fanout PASS (so / v decode <= ~25 loads), 4 depth PASS (+1 AND / 2:1 mux before o), 5 storage waived (the 4 x 562 landing ring is the LANDING-CONTRACT ring, no runtime-indexed flop array beyond it, unchanged), 6 floorplan waived (pin-limited face strip abutted to the slice S face, aspect as the closed p3 / relays; no macros), 7 clock PASS (two roots unchanged, io_hold_margin 0.03), 8 schedule PASS (static, 0 cycles).
